scripts.lint:changes: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep '\.php$' | xargs vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=phpcs.xml --extensions=php -q
scripts.lint:fix:changes: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep '\.php$' | xargs vendor/bin/phpcbf --standard=phpcs.xml --extensions=php -q
scripts.test:report:reset: rm -rf tests/_output/allure-results tests/_output/report tests/_output/report-share tests/_output/record_* tests/_output/Tests.EndToEnd.*.html tests/_output/Tests.EndToEnd.*.png

scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run PHPStan static analysis at the level set in phpstan.neon. Findings that predate the analysis are suppressed by phpstan-baseline.neon, so a failure means new code introduced it.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan:baseline: Regenerate phpstan-baseline.neon from the current findings. Only run this when intentionally accepting new suppressions, otherwise fix the reported errors instead.
scripts-descriptions.test:bootstrap: Set up the local test WP install: scaffold WordPress core, configure it against SQLite, install WP, place the SQLite Database Integration mu-plugin, and copy project mu-plugins from tests/_mu-plugins/. Idempotent, fires from post-autoload-dump on every composer install/update/dump-autoload.
scripts-descriptions.test:chromedriver: Download a Chromedriver build matching the local Chrome. Run once after a Chrome update if E2E tests start failing with a 'session not created' driver mismatch.
scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Bootstrap the test env (idempotent), match Chromedriver to Chrome, and (re)generate Codeception Actor classes. Called automatically by test:e2e.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:snapshots: Rewrite the request-body fixtures in tests/Support/Data/snapshots/ from what KP currently sends, then review the diff, the fixture is the assertion. Run after an intended change to a Klarna payload.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the Integration suite. Requires a generated tests/Support/Data/dump.sql, and will share the SQLite database with test:harness, so never run the two at once.
scripts-descriptions.test:harness: Run the tests that cover the test harness itself, the subscriptions fake and the artifact redaction, rather than the plugin. Shares the SQLite database with test:integration, so never run the two at once.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run the EndToEnd suite. Requires NGROK_DOMAIN, NGROK_AUTHTOKEN, KLARNA_TEST_MID_SE, KLARNA_TEST_SECRET_SE in tests/.env, plus a generated tests/Support/Data/dump.sql.
scripts-descriptions.test:regenerate-dump: Rebuild tests/Support/Data/dump.sql from a clean WP+WC+KP install. Run after upstream WC or KP changes that affect baseline schema/options.
scripts-descriptions.test:report: Render the Allure report from whichever suite results are present into tests/_output/report/. Fails if any credential leaked into an artifact.
scripts-descriptions.test:report:share: Same, but one self-contained tests/_output/report-share/index.html for sharing outside the dev team.
scripts-descriptions.test:report:reset: Delete all accumulated Allure results and rendered reports.
